patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive background imagery serves as the primary visual canvas, often overlaid with large, central typographic elements.
Heavily distressed, uppercase, and wide-tracked display typography is used for all major section headings, creating a retro-futuristic, almost glitched aesthetic.
A high-contrast dark mode palette dominates, featuring deep blacks and dark grays, punctuated by vibrant amber/orange accents and occasional purple/teal highlights within imagery.
Scroll-triggered animations reveal large typographic elements and image grids with staggered fade-ins or subtle slides as they enter the viewport, enhancing the immersive experience.
Sections are defined by expansive, full-width typographic statements rather than traditional content blocks, creating a strong visual rhythm and hierarchy.

technique_notes: An initial full-screen loading experience with a retro-futuristic UI and progress bar sets the site's aesthetic before content loads, using CSS keyframes for animation.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely orchestrated with GSAP and Locomotive Scroll, reveal large, distressed text headings and image cards as they enter the viewport, often with a staggered fade-in or subtle slide effect.
Full-bleed background images utilize parallax scrolling to create depth and movement against foreground content, enhancing the sense of a dynamic environment.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, distressed display headings (~8x body) with wide-tracked uppercase labels and smaller, legible body text for UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal rounding applied subtly to image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical spacing between large typographic sections and elements, contributing to a grand, expansive feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of heavily distressed, oversized typography combined with a dark, retro-futuristic UI and complex scroll-triggered animations creates an immersive, almost cinematic experience. It feels less like a traditional website and more like navigating a digital art installation, making the brand feel cutting-edge and artistic.
